growing_conditions.location: Buon Ma Thuot, Dak Lak, Vietnam (12.68N, 108.04E)

crop.stage_note: harvest and sun-drying: excess rain delays picking and causes mold in drying yards — wetness is the risk, not drought

forecast.note: forward-looking model output; verified against realized rainfall in the public track record as windows close

brief: Coffee futures closed at 276¢/lb — down 2.3% on the week and down 3.9% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 52 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (-0.7σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is low. A weakening Brazilian real (+5.7% in a month) raises producers' local-currency revenue per bag — added selling pressure. Looking ahead: the 14-day forecast calls for 22 mm of rain in the robusta belt against a 23 mm seasonal norm (-0.1σ) — projected crop stress: low (Open-Meteo forecast model, issued 2026-11-28; skill scored publicly as windows close).
